prompt:
Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density.
Original character design, not resembling any Nintendo/Game Freak/Pokémon character. Edit target first image: tiles-interior-surfaces-v3. Other three images style references only. Keep exact 4x4 tile order and fully opaque edge-to-edge surfaces, no margins. Simplify all textures to STRICT 16x16 logical pixels per cell, large blocky pixels. Especially row1 col2 wood: three wide horizontal planks, clearly visible thick dark seams at logical rows 0,5,10,15 and staggered vertical joints. No grain noise. Row1 col1 tatami: one pale straw mat texture, thin green binding at left and right, no subdivided mat patchwork. Row3 col3 rug: muted flat terracotta woven surface, sparse simple tiny marks, no noisy checkerboard. Walls smooth cream, no speckle. Preserve window and shoji designs, simplify to 16-pixel clusters. Wall top row2 col3 must be solid dark walnut top surface across entire cell. Every floor repeats without a border or gutters. All other objects keep their placement.
